mapper.sql: r.id, r.selection_id, r.student_id, r.course_id, r.teacher_id, r.semester_id, r.score_content, r.score_teaching, r.score_attitude, r.score_gain, r.average_score, r.content, r.anonymous, r.status, r.submit_time, r.create_time, r.update_time, su.real_name AS studentName, st.stu_no AS stuNo, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.course_name AS courseName, tu.real_name AS teacherName, se.semester_name AS semesterName

LEFT JOIN student st ON st.id = r.student_id AND st.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = st.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = r.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.id = r.teacher_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = t.user_id AND tu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN semester se ON se.id = r.semester_id AND se.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.course_name AS courseName, tu.real_name AS teacherName, se.semester_name AS semesterName, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN r.average_score END), 1), 0) AS averageScore, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN r.score_content END), 1), 0) AS scoreContent, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN r.score_teaching END), 1), 0) AS scoreTeaching, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN r.score_attitude END), 1), 0) AS scoreAttitude, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN r.score_gain END), 1), 0) AS scoreGain, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection sel WHERE sel.course_id = c.id AND sel.status = 2 AND sel.deleted = 0) AS studentCount FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.id = c.teacher_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = t.user_id AND tu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN semester se ON se.id = c.semester_id AND se.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course_review r ON r.course_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.id = #{courseId} GROUP BY c.id, c.course_code, c.course_name, tu.real_name, se.semester_name

SELECT
FROM course_review r
WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.course_id = #{courseId} AND r.status = 2 ORDER BY r.average_score DESC, r.submit_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN 1 END) AS reviewCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS publishedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS hiddenCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN r.average_score END), 1), 0) AS averageScore, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status <> 3 THEN r.course_id END) AS courseCount FROM course_review r WHERE r.deleted = 0
AND r.semester_id = #{semesterId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 2 AND course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND selection_id = #{selectionId}
